messages:
deploybot: PREMERGE EVAL: summarizer-prompt-suite failed quality gate for release/2026.03.20
deploybot: metric delta: ROUGE-L -3.2% (threshold -2.0%), hallucination-rate +1.1pp (threshold +0.5pp) — auto-hold triggered.
deploybot: Actions available: 1) request manual override by product + eng 2) pin previous model version 3) rollback current candidate. Please respond with /deploybot decide <option>.
samir: Saw the fail. first-pass looks like shortened outputs causing rouge drop. might be the token truncation tweak from the tokenizer patch.
maddie: tagging product: @alejandra do we have approval to accept this delta for the release window? we have enterprise customers waiting.
alejandra: Not comfortable shipping a >2% ROUGE drop. Need root-cause and a canary plan. Can we pin the model for hosted and continue testing on Dedicated?
samir: We can pin to v2026-03-10 for hosted quickly. That keeps throughput and avoids rollforward. Will need a hotfix branch to revert tokenizer tweak.
jia: FYI change window closes in 90 minutes. If we pin, we still need a release note update and a rollback plan if pinned model shows infra issues.
release-manager-bot: NOTE: If manual override selected, must include a release notes blurb and QA signoff within 30 minutes to keep changewindow.
maddie: OK propose: pin hosted to v2026-03-10, schedule hotfix revert onto candidate branch, re-run prompt-suite on a small sample, and ship patch in next change window if green. Anyone object? :thinking_face:
alejandra: +1 for pin. product will sign off after sample re-run (need screenshots of failure modes).
samir: I'll create the pin PR and patch branch now. commands:
```
# pin hosted
/deploybot pin --env hosted --model v2026-03-10 --reason "premerge eval failure: summarizer suite"
# create hotfix
git checkout -b hotfix/revert-tokenizer && git push origin hotfix/revert-tokenizer
```
jia: I'll stand by to run the reduced prompt-suite on dedicated and share metrics. If we get ROUGE back within -0.5% and hallucination under +0.3pp, product can signoff.
release-manager-bot: Pin request logged: ticket RH-4721. Please update ticket with sample results and release note snippet: "Pinned to v2026-03-10 due to premerge summarizer regression; patch in progress."
maddie: Adding release note: "Temporarily pin summarizer model in hosted to maintain output quality while we revert tokenizer tweak; no customer impact expected."
samir: /deploybot decide pin — executing now.
deploybot: ACTION: pinned hosted -> v2026-03-10. Routing rules unchanged. Canary routing paused for candidate v2026-03-20.
samir: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/1287 (hotfix/revert-tokenizer) — running local suite then pushing.
jia: running reduced suite now, ETA 12m. will paste results.
(12m later)
jia: reduced-suite results: ROUGE-L delta -0.4%, hallucination +0.2pp. Plot and logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood/reports/RH-4721/run-2026-03-20
alejandra: Good enough for product signoff. Maddie please add to release notes and mark ticket RH-4721 resolved once hotfix merges.
maddie: Done. release notes updated and ticket commented. Good triage everyone :thumbsup:
samir: Hotfix merged, will schedule full regression run in staging and monitor canary after next change window.
release-manager-bot: CHANGE WINDOW: close in 45m. Current status: pinned hosted model; hotfix merged to main; post-merge full-suite scheduled.
deploybot: thread closed by action pin. If further regressions observed reopen thread or file new premerge eval ticket.
